teaser: Lovable's agent can change production; its controls are real, its defaults open, and a policy says what each project's agent may do.
core_idea: Lovable's agent applies code directly, changes the live database and auth, calls connected systems and publishes, and can run for hours on a goal. Lovable provides per-action permissions, Plan mode, migration approval, security scans, publish blocks, workspace policies, a pre-prompt hook, audit logs and AIUC-1 certification. Nine of ten backend permissions default to Always allow and are set per user across all workspaces. An Agent Behaviour Policy records each project's mandate and which settings should ask, beside the platform's certificate.
